papers_primary_locators.gate: Conserve energy and angular momentum, check horizon geometry and cosmic censorship; explicit fragmentation dynamics and rate not provided.

papers_primary_locators.title: AGC 322753: a Dark Galaxy Candidate detected by ALFALFA and FASHI
papers_primary_locators.gate: HI interferometric sky map plus deep optical follow-up; tidal gas or faint stellar counterpart remains possible; not disproof of dark matter.

papers_primary_locators.title: Ultrafast Single Qubit Gates through Multi-Photon Transition Removal
papers_primary_locators.gate: Single transmon demonstrated, extension to entangled/multi-qubit processor and drift/benchmark NOT_RUN.

papers_primary_locators.title: Real-Time Observation of Aharonov-Bohm Interference in a Z2 Lattice Gauge Theory on a Hybrid Qubit-Oscillator Quantum Computer
papers_primary_locators.gate: Validate Gauss constraint, flux dependence, finite size and noise; not an observation of spacetime gravitational reconnection.

papers_primary_locators.title: Non-Gaussian heavy-quark transport in quark-gluon plasma
papers_primary_locators.gate: Compute higher cumulants/non-Gaussian tails and compare heavy-flavor data independently; not cosmological age estimate.
